_comment: Publisher rename map for scripts/check_catalog_source_dupes.py. A repository that moves to a new owner looks like a brand-new publisher to an offline sweep, which is how two guides for one project get published. Add the retired identity here (lower case, keyed by old owner/repo) with the current owner/repo as the value. No catalog guide may cite a retired key; the gate fails until the page is repointed or removed.
